account:
Today has been quiet as far as I have personally learned. During my morning market walk, several residents said they had no news. I heard residents asking the builder for an update on town works, but I have not heard any actual report of problems or projects. At my scheduled accounts appointment I found 128 emeralds in the treasury. The secretary says no bills, council papers, or further correspondence have reached them.

The secretary personally confirmed my three o'clock tea with the neighbour at the east-bank cottage, road point (16, -60, 105), and has a written address. I intend to go there and return to the office at sixteen thirty.

The notable new business is the innkeeper's request for a meeting tomorrow at eighteen in the great hall about the inn's service to town. I agreed and asked the secretary to record it. The innkeeper now proposes meeting me at my office at seventeen forty-five and walking over together; the secretary is still asking for explicit confirmation. This seems to be a planned discussion of the inn's town services. I have no evidence of any other purpose or anything improper, and do not yet know what specific proposals the innkeeper wants to raise.
